## Goal
Cover truth outside the Python server adapter: TypeScript/Svelte HTTP/WebSocket clients and deployment/Docker/runtime configuration that changes externally observed route behavior.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] finite normalized client URL/method extraction
- [ ] join only to established/explicit server surface IDs
- [ ] query strings retained as evidence but normalized out of route identity
- [ ] WebSocket client support
- [ ] Docker/env/subprocess observation contracts
- [ ] no cross-language global URL fanout
- [ ] evaluate the nine audited non-Python cases separately
conclusion: GH108 says “nine audited non-Python cases” without defining the unit, and its issue comment thread is empty. The frozen ranked audit index identifies six PRs; their audited truth comprises eight client HTTP route atoms plus one conditional deployment route atom, which could be the intended nine. No other PR identities can be inferred from available evidence. This evaluation reports six PRs and nine atoms separately and makes no full-acceptance claim.
